# umami_team (Resource)

An Umami team. Websites assigned to a team are visible to its members. The authenticated user becomes the team owner. Deleting a team first moves its remaining websites to the authenticated user, because Umami would otherwise leave them unreachable. See [documentation](https://docs.umami.is/docs/api/teams) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "umami_team" "example" {
  name = "Example Client"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the team.

### Read-Only

- `access_code` (String, Sensitive) Code that users can enter to join the team.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) ID (UUID) of the team.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import umami_team.example 5e1ba5a1-263f-4edc-ba3a-988342134d17
```
